skills.name: vacant
skills.description: Check whether domain names are registered, available, reserved, or invalid. Use when the user asks if a domain is taken or free, wants to find an unregistered name, brainstorms project or product names that need a domain, screens candidates across many TLDs, or filters a list of domains to only the available ones. Queries authoritative TLD nameservers directly — fast, accurate, and not rate-limited like WHOIS.
